in_marathi.name: Shivananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shiva is the graceful God, who is full of compassion and is the embodiment of peace, calmness and tranquility. Nanda means graceful or peaceful.
